name: Kimi Nishimura
source:
Club President for the school’s Literature club. Kimi takes a no nonsense attitude when her time is devoted to school, but will be  friendly enough to engage in helping the club reach it’s true potential. As a secluded flirtatious type, she will not seek out attention, but will playfully engage if introduced.

[From [url=https://www.tsofgame.com/characters]official website[/url]]
